title: Outreach Pipeline Plan
summary: Full outreach pipeline plan covering 675 Apollo contacts plus 37 existing leads.
content:
Outreach Pipeline Plan -- 2026-03-07

Summary

  • Total contacts in plan: 675 (Apollo export) + 37 (Feb 28 log-only batch)
  • Tier 1 (warm -- opened, no reply): 114 total | 23 ICP | 91 off-ICP
  • Tier 2 ICP (uncontacted, on-target): 160
  • Tier 2 off-ICP (uncontacted, low priority): 190
  • Tier 3 (cold ghost -- sent, never opened): 198 total | 48 ICP | 150 off-ICP
  • Skipped (bounced/replied/DNC): 13
  • Feb 28 log-only batch (not in CSV): 37 contacts -- check-ins already drafted in jacob-session.md, awaiting Patrik's go

Key Findings

CSV vs. Cold Outreach Log Reconciliation

The Apollo CSV export is a different dataset from the cold-outreach-log. Most of the Feb 22-23 and Feb 18-19 batch contacts are not in the CSV -- they were sourced and emailed through a separate Apollo pipeline, then only logged in cold-outreach-log.md. The CSV appears to be a fresh contact export (likely pulled for this pipeline session).

Only 4 of the 37 Feb 28 log contacts appear in the CSV:

  • Alan Kushmakov (Best Homes Real Estate) -- CSV shows Email Sent: true, Stage: Unresponsive, Last Contacted: 2026-03-03
  • Garrett Nybo (Wespac Construction) -- CSV shows Email Sent: true, Stage: Approaching
  • Lorraine Bergman (Caliente Construction) -- CSV shows Email Sent: blank, Stage: Cold (but log says emailed Feb 28)
  • Robert Levine (LevRose Commercial Real Estate) -- CSV shows Email Sent: blank, Stage: Cold (same flag)

This means the CSV's "Email Sent" field is NOT fully synced with what the cold-outreach-log tracks. The log is the source of truth for who has been emailed.

Tier 1 Reality Check

114 contacts opened the email but never replied. However, 91 of them (80%) are in off-ICP verticals -- financial services, insurance, automotive. These opened likely out of curiosity, not genuine need for video content. The 23 ICP openers are in healthcare (10) and real estate (13). All were contacted ~330-340 days ago (Mar-Apr 2025). Re-intro territory, not a bump.

Tier 3 Reality Check

198 cold ghosts. 48 are ICP (construction 11, real estate 30, healthcare 7). All 198 were contacted 294-343 days ago -- essentially all in the 90+ day re-intro bucket. The original email clearly didn't land. These need a new angle, not a nudge.

Alan Kushmakov Anomaly

Alan Kushmakov (Best Homes Real Estate) appears in Tier 3 via the CSV (Email Sent: true, not opened) but is also in the Feb 28 log as a check-in target. His CSV "Last Contacted" is 2026-03-03 (4 days ago from our perspective, meaning an email may have gone out). The Feb 28 check-in is already drafted in jacob-session.md (#10). Do not double-contact.

ICP Analysis

Construction -- TOP PRIORITY. 50 uncontacted in Tier 2, 11 in Tier 3 (cold ghost). This is the target vertical for AOM's $45k/month retainer goal. Lots of small-to-mid contractors, restoration companies, roofing, electric, insulation. Strong decision-makers (owners, presidents) with real email addresses. These are the most valuable contacts in the entire export.

Real estate -- High value, secondary. 31 uncontacted in Tier 2, 30 in Tier 3. Most are brokers and designated brokers -- they care about listings content, agent recruiting, and brand video. Solid candidates for project-based work if not retainers.

Hospitality -- Good fit, smaller pool. 18 uncontacted in Tier 2. Restaurants, resorts, hospitality management groups. Event season content, brand video, social media. Good for retainers if they're independent operators.

Nonprofit -- Moderate priority. 27 uncontacted in Tier 2. Strong story potential, but budgets are tighter. Good for documentary-style and impact storytelling work. Not retainer candidates -- project-based only.

Health/Fitness -- Niche but worth it. 11 uncontacted. Local studios, wellness founders. Social content is natural fit.

Healthcare -- Lower priority than it looks. Most of the 23 Tier 1 openers and 7 Tier 3 ghosts are healthcare -- but many are home health care agencies, tribal health centers, and regional systems. Not local Phoenix small businesses. National orgs or government-adjacent. Worth one touch for the right contacts, but temper expectations.

Off-ICP (financial services, insurance, automotive, IT/SaaS): 190 uncontacted + 91 warm openers + 150 cold ghosts = 431 contacts. These are off-ICP verticals. Do not prioritize. Patrik to decide if/when to run them, but they are not the path to construction retainers.

30-Day Schedule

Days 1-3 are already covered by the 39 emails in jacob-session.md (37 Feb 28 check-ins + 2 priority replies). Those are pending Patrik's "go."
